constraints.text: Escalate to a senior agent after the maximum number of correction retries
Order agent does nothing once the request is escalated
Refund agent does nothing once the request is escalated
A human must approve a refund before the refund tool runs
Frustrated or angry complaints need human review
Complaints go to the response node when retries run out
Finished conversations of more than six messages are summarized
An order id must be valid before the order is looked up
A refund request must pass validation (reason length and similar)
